name: ITSM-Agentic: K8s CrashLoopBackOff Use Case (Induce + Ticket) - Worker1OL

nodes.name: Induce CrashLoopBackOff Pod (SSH)
nodes.notes: Bare Pod, not a Deployment, per request. busybox exits 1 immediately on every start -- kubelet's restartPolicy: Always keeps restarting it, and after a few restarts kubernetes marks it CrashLoopBackOff.

nodes.name: Expose Pod as NodePort Service (SSH)
nodes.notes: NodePort (not ClusterIP) so the exposed service can be curled directly on the Worker1OL host for later validation, per request.

nodes.name: Wait for Restart Backoff
nodes.notes: Gives kubelet time to cycle through enough crash/restart iterations for the status to actually reach CrashLoopBackOff (exponential backoff, not instantaneous).

parameters.command: echo '--- kubectl get pods ---'; kubectl get pods -n default -l run=crashloop-demo -o wide; echo '--- kubectl describe pod (tail) ---'; kubectl describe pod -n default -l run=crashloop-demo | tail -n 20; echo '--- nodeport ---'; kubectl get svc crashloop-demo -n default -o jsonpath='{.spec.ports[0].nodePort}'

nodes.name: Capture Live CrashLoopBackOff Proof (SSH)
nodes.notes: Live diagnostic evidence embedded into the ticket description below, same 'ground the ticket in real state' pattern the SRE daemon's own SOP synthesizer expects (see daemon/sop/synthesizer.py's diagnostic-context rules).
